notes.title: Episode 2 Update
notes.content:
Episode 2 update is live.
Finally, you can play the full story.
Episode 2 will be available only in English, German and Russian language right now. All supported languages will be available soon.
Have fun dino hunters.
I've added an extra button to the main menu to start Episode 2 directly.

notes.title: Patch 1.02 notes
notes.content:
Hello,
A new patch is now available:
- achievements fix (now achievements should work properly)
- bridge collider (there was a hole in collider)
- fixed floating trees
- dinos ragdoll fix 
- fixed bug with a campfire and other actions in the same time
- fixed shooting from small distance

notes.title: Patch 1.01 notes
notes.content:
Hello,
A new patch is available.
Fixing a few most annoying issues in the game:
- code to the lock door don't disappear (if you forget the code you can reed it again)
- now all dinos give different amount of meat. It is more rewording to hunt big dinos.
- fixed some objects collisions
- fixed puzzle with code (now you can't walk over the wall)
- fixed puzzle with a canyon (now you can't walk over the canyon)
- fixed keybinding problems
- fixed invert mouse setting
